title: Switch-on-NodeType / If-Chains on Component Types
description: Using if/switch chains to dispatch behavior based on node type or component type. This violates Open/Closed principle — adding a new type requires modifying every switch statement. Found in legacy code: scene_loader.cpp and scene_saver.cpp have if-chains on NodeType. The correct approach is polymorphic dispatch via virtual interfaces or ECS system queries (registry.view<Component>()).
whenToUse: When reviewing scene loading, saving, or any code that dispatches on entity/node types. When adding new component types.
